title: After the Debut: The Lingering Scent of Turf

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ines Fujin has survived her debut race. Even after crossing the finish line, her excitement shows no signs of dying down, and her heart races wildly.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The pounding in Ines Fujin's chest takes her back to a moment in which she felt profoundly inspired by the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Reminded of that time, she sets her sights on winning the Japanese Derby herself. She knows it might seem like a rash decision, but Ines Fujin wants what she wants!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: To prepare ourselves for this bold goal, we decide to take on a G1 race that's host to a gathering of fierce junior-year racers. It's settled—our next goal is the Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes!
